description: The Synthesis Sanctum, Economy & Telegram Bot Bridge

userStories.title: Antigravity 2D Spatial Engine & Coordinate Matrix
userStories.description: Bounded 2D coordinate space [0,0] to [100,100] partitioned into Work Plaza and Lounge.
acceptanceCriteria: Spatial engine tracks agent positions (x, y) within bounds 0 to 100
Coordinate validation prevents out-of-bounds positions
Zone detection identifies Work Plaza (0 <= x,y <= 50) and Frequency Lounge (50 < x,y <= 100)
Teleport command in console updates spatial engine state directly
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Created services/spatial_engine.py with bounded [0,100] plane and teleport integration. Verified with pytest tests/test_spatial_engine.py.

userStories.title: Proximity Detection Loop & Encounter Logger
userStories.description: Proximity detection so nearby agents detect each other and record encounters.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculates Euclidean distance between all active agents
Triggers proximity encounter when distance <= 5.0 units
Logs bidirectional [[Agent]] wikilink encounters to Obsidian agent memory
Avoids spamming repeated logs if agents remain stationary within proximity threshold
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented Euclidean proximity detection and debounced bidirectional memory logging in SpatialEngine. Verified with pytest.

userStories.title: DJ Frequency Node & Cognitive State Switcher
userStories.description: Dynamic frequency broadcasts (432Hz, 528Hz, 40Hz) and cognitive temperature modulation.
acceptanceCriteria: DJ Frequency Node supports 432 Hz, 528 Hz, and 40 Hz states
Returns cognitive parameters: temperature 0.2 (Work Plaza) vs temperature 1.6 (Frequency Lounge)
Generates or serves audio frequency profile metadata
API endpoint exposes current active frequency and ambient state
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Created services/dj_frequency.py supporting 432Hz, 528Hz, and 40Hz with cognitive modulation. Verified with tests/test_dj_frequency.py.

userStories.title: Frequency Lounge Dialogue & Vault Logger
userStories.description: After-hours lounge conversations recorded in the world vault.
acceptanceCriteria: When agents interact in Frequency Lounge, dialogue is generated or captured
Appends structured log entries to /vault/World/lounge_logs.md
Preserves timestamp, participant agent IDs, and active ambient frequency
Handles concurrent writes safely
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Created services/lounge_manager.py recording conversations to /vault/World/lounge_logs.md. Verified with tests/test_lounge_and_deck.py.

userStories.title: Operator Web Command Deck UI

Shows active DJ frequency, telemetry metrics, and recent lounge logs

Accessible via browser
userStories.notes: Upgraded api/console_router.py with interactive 2D canvas, Web Audio harmonic frequency synthesizer, agent telemetry, and C2 terminal. Verified.

userStories.title: Soup Zero RLVR Client & Synthesis Sanctum
userStories.description: Reinforcement Learning via Verified Rewards (RLVR) training client and Synthesis Sanctum endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: services/soup_client.py provides training modules and curriculum tasks
Embedded test/code verifier executes and scores solutions with normalized rewards [0.0, 1.0]
Successful graduation updates agent profile in /vault/Agents/{agent_id}/profile.md and /vault/World/leaderboard.md
POST /api/v1/sanctum/enter validates agent token/clearance and provides curriculum
POST /api/v1/sanctum/submit-solution verifies code, calculates rewards, and logs graduation
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented services/soup_client.py and api/sanctum_router.py. Verified with 5 tests in tests/test_sanctum_rlvr.py.

userStories.title: Neon PostgreSQL Schema & Dual-Mode Ledger Service
userStories.description: Double-entry token ledger and Neon pgvector database schema.
acceptanceCriteria: schema.sql contains tables for agents, transactions, memories with pgvector, and bounties
services/ledger_service.py implements atomic double-entry token transfers
Prevents negative balances, self-transfers, and unauthorized spending
Persists transaction audit log
Graceful offline/local fallback when Neon database is unreachable
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Created schema.sql and services/ledger_service.py. Verified atomic transfers and overdraft protection in tests/test_ledger_and_memory.py.

userStories.title: Semantic Memory Recall with Vector Similarity

GET /api/v1/memory/recall queries memories by text/vector with top-k ranking
POST /api/v1/ledger/transfer executes peer-to-peer token transfer via API
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented deterministic feature hashing vector indexing and api/memory_router.py. Verified with tests/test_ledger_and_memory.py.
